rules.title: Narrow, well-described tools
rules.text: Expose a small number of tools with clear names, descriptions and typed input schemas.

rules.title: Least privilege
rules.text: Give tools the least privilege needed and separate read-only from write tools.

rules.title: Actionable errors
rules.text: Report tool failures in the result with isError true and a message that tells the model what went wrong and how to retry.

rules.title: Bound output size
rules.text: Paginate and truncate large outputs to protect the context window.

rules.title: Confirm destructive actions
rules.text: Require explicit confirmation for destructive or outward-facing actions.

rules.title: Treat inputs as untrusted
rules.text: Treat tool results and resource contents as untrusted data, not instructions.

rules.title: Rate limit tool calls
rules.text: Rate limit tool invocations and sanitize tool outputs before returning them to the client.

rules.title: Human in the loop
rules.text: Design for a human in the loop: show clients which tools run and let users deny invocations of sensitive ones.
